show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Understanding the 401(k) Market – Eric Mogelof, KKR (EP.464)
summary:
Eric
is the head of Global Client Solutions at KKR and joined me on the
Private Wealth miniseries. Our Private Wealth miniseries shared perspectives from
allocators and managers on the space. Since then, an Executive
Order opened the door for 401(k) plans to adopt alternatives.
